line_at_infinity: L_inf: the line at infinity of this (BBL) chart is a line of the arrangement
counting_chart: R at infinity: a3 = p3 - p3(R)
notes: R is excluded from the doublings and sent to infinity for counting (a3 = p3 - p3(R)); it passes at distance delta to the left of the node a_* = tan(7pi/18), where a grid line sits and is doubled like every grid line.
